verdict.rationale: Drata's own developer docs claim it can accelerate security reviews and "automate questionnaires" alongside trust-center management, so questionnaire automation is a first-party capability. However, the evidence is a single thin marketing line with no detail. missing for 10: evidence that answers are AI-generated, evidence that drafts are grounded in the customer's actual controls and knowledge base, a human review/approval workflow for drafts, and in-depth documentation or independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill

citations.quote: Accelerate security reviews and trust assurance. Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically.
